text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You know... they say these stairs gain an 
extra step in the evening...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"It's so fun, like magic... I've been 
counting them... for about an hour now..."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... Because no matter how many times 
I count... it doesn't go up... by even one 
step..."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: A-Alright... I'll count one more time...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Tenacity is a good thing, but... it seems 
to have backfired this time, leaving her 
completely exhausted."
